title: 8. Coin Change (Minimum Coins)
description:
You are given an integer array `coins` representing coins of different denominations and an integer `amount` representing a total amount of money.

Return the fewest number of coins that you need to make up that amount. If that amount of money cannot be made up by any combination of the coins, return `-1`.
constraints:
• 1 <= len(coins) <= 12
• 1 <= coins[i] <= 2^31 - 1
• 0 <= amount <= 10^4
• Optimal Time: O(amount * len(coins)) | Space: O(amount)
explanation: 1D DP array `dp[a]` stores the minimum coins needed for amount `a`. For each coin `c`, `dp[a] = min(dp[a], dp[a - c] + 1)`. Unbounded coin reuse is supported by forward iteration from `c` to `amount`.
